mission: Make liquidity understandable without confusing observed market depth with locked/protected liquidity or with a promise that liquidity will remain.
truthRules: Observed liquidity and LP protection are separate facts.
Aggregate observed pair liquidity is not labelled protocol TVL.
Do not double-count duplicate pair addresses.
Deepest observed market is selected by reported USD liquidity, with provider attribution.
No automatic LP move, rebalance, compound, zap, migration or withdrawal occurs from intelligence data.

xrpl.rule: Do not force Solana LP concepts onto XRPL order-book markets. Quote CLOB and AMM independently and explain which path supplies the market.

model: marketplace/order liquidity for native Bitcoin assets
verified wrapped-BTC liquidity only on non-Bitcoin chains
